item.summary: B Treasury Capital AB (publ), the Spotlight-listed Swedish bitcoin treasury company, on 17 November 2026 announced a directed issue of 43,517 Class A preference shares (BTC PREF) at SEK 120.00 per share, raising approximately SEK 5.2 million before estimated costs of about SEK 0.3 million. The issue adds eleven new holders of the preference shares, including the company Tellus Equity AB, which according to the notice will hold about 12 per cent of outstanding BTC PREF after the issue; one subscriber is a related party and subscribed on the same terms as the other investors. The board resolved on the issue under an authorisation from the annual general meeting on 31 March 2026, and registration with the Swedish Companies Registration Office is expected in week 48 (23–27 November 2026). The company says the net proceeds will be used to acquire bitcoin, to redeem Class B shares when deemed accretive, and to strengthen its liquidity reserve.
